# apicp_database (Resource)

Manages a MySQL/MariaDB or PostgreSQL database (plus a matching admin user of the same name) via apicp. The generated password is returned exactly once, on create — apicp never stores or re-returns it, so `password` is only known immediately after `terraform apply` creates the resource; it reads back as unknown (not empty) after an import or a refresh of an existing resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apicp_database" "example" {
  engine = "postgresql" # or "mysql"
  name   = "example_app"
}

output "example_db_password" {
  value     = apicp_database.example.password
  sensitive = true
}

# A database linked to the website that uses it is backed up in that
# website's archive, so the site and its data are restored together.
resource "apicp_web_domain" "shop" {
  domain = "shop.example.com"
}

resource "apicp_database" "shop" {
  engine   = "mysql"
  name     = "shop_wp"
  vhost_id = apicp_web_domain.shop.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `engine` (String) `mysql` (MariaDB) or `postgresql`. Changing this replaces the resource.
- `name` (String) Database (and matching admin username) — apicp's current MVP uses one user per database, named the same as the database. Changing this replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `vhost_id` (String) ID of the `apicp_web_domain` (a website of the same account) that uses this database. A linked database is backed up in that website's archive, so the site and its data are restored together; an unlinked one goes in the account's settings archive. Changing it only changes the link (nothing on the database server is touched); `""` removes the link. Leave it out to leave the link as it is on the server (apicp's importer and `apicp db link` set it too) - it then shows the server's value. apicp removes the link itself when the website is deleted. Needs apicp v0.7.0 or later.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `node_id` (String)
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Generated database password. Only populated in the apply that creates this resource — see the resource description.
- `status` (String)
- `username` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apicp_database.example db_abc123
```
